title: The Awakening: Prologue to the Saturn Chronicles
author: PKProStudio
description:
"One man begins the longest journey of his life in this prologue to the upcoming Saturn Chronicles"

***Author's Note*** This is my first ever interactive fiction. I just started learning Inform 7 and I am planning to create a series of interactive fictions with it. This game is the very short prologue to the series, and is not very impressive. I hope to learn to utilize many more features in the future and make more complicated games.
